paite: TOUPA phat un, TOUPA kihtami in nuam asa hi, athupiakte a nakpitak a kipakmi in.
heading: Mihoih Kipahna

paite: Asuante lei ah hattak in a-om ding ua; midiktat khang vualzawl in a-om ding hi.
A-inn ah sum leh hauhsakna a-om a; adiktatna tangtawn a om ding ahi.
Midik a ding in mial ah vakna hong pawtkhia; amah mihehpih thei, zahngaihna a dim diktat ahi.
Mite hehpih a leitawisakmi hoih in avuk nak a; amah kizentak in akhosa ding hi.
Bangchik mah chiang a ling lou ding ahi ngal a; midiktat tangtawn a theihgige in a-om ding hi.
Tanchin hoih loutakte a lau kei ding, TOUPA muang in alungtang akip ahi.
Alungtang akip a, alau kei ding, amah doute tung a alunggulh a hihtangtung amuh masiah.
Ahawmzak a, gentheite kiang ah apia, adiktatna tangtawn a om ding ahi; akii zahtaktak a pahtawi in a-om ding hi.
Migilou-salou in huai amu ding a, aheh ding a, aha agawi ding a azulmang ding, migilou-saloute deihlam amang ding hi.
